_about: Corrections of the official EN client text: { "<Chinese data text>": "<English>" }, tried BEFORE the official EN data (tools/build-i18n.mjs; another language has its own corrections-<code>.json). Only for an official translation that contradicts the Chinese text and the engine; each entry has a `_why:<key start>` note. Raw keys only: the plain twin (desc / effectDesc) is derived by stripping the markup.
_why:<@ba.vup>携带装备</>的【维多利亚】: Victoria Alliance, 6 operators: the Chinese says +50% ATK per equipment carried (每携带1件装备), +80% per advanced one; server/sim/content/bonds/core.js installVictoria adds atk_normal_equip / +atk_golden_equip per item. The official EN ('gain +50% ATK, or +80% ATK if equipment is upgraded') reads as a flat bonus.
